verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly instruct developers to reuse OpenAI's client libraries by only changing api_key and base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, and describe the API as 'mostly compatible with OpenAI's client libraries.' This is corroborated by community reports of using Groq via standard OpenAI-compatible tooling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a literal drop-in swap with zero code changes beyond base_url/key (some community complaints about reliability/quirks suggest occasional compatibility edge cases).
